verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a homepage claim that you can 'describe what you want in plain text and let Bento's powerful AI build it for you' (bento-docs-10). That suggests built-in AI generation from a brief, but it never says the output is email copy or subject lines, or that it runs inside the composer. The MCP server (bento-docs-5) is external-assistant access, not built-in composer AI, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that AI drafts or refines subject lines and body copy, in-composer placement, documentation of the refine workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
